thread:
Kai: Quick check — we need to lock the final pre-cut checkpoint for release v2.3.2. Goal: pick a 30m go/no-go slot and confirm canary owners + DB migration window. Proposed slots: 1) Tue 08:30-09:00 PT, 2) Tue 16:30-17:00 UTC, 3) Wed 01:00-01:30 PT. Please vote with :one:/:two:/:three: and call out any conflicts.

Maya: +1 for slot 1 (08:30 PT). SRE can make that but we need a primary and backup for canaries.

Rory: Slot 2 works better for me (16:30 UTC) — I might be offline for slot 1. I can own canary A if someone takes canary B.

Jules: I'm OOO Wed so slot 3 is a hard no from me. If we pick slot 1, can someone confirm DB migration dry-run status?

PM-Jen: Product available slot 1. Need a quick 5m sync before the meeting for feature-owner handoff. Can we add that to the agenda?

Kai: Yes — adding a 5m handoff at start. Draft agenda (30m total):
• 00:00–05:00 — feature-owner handoff (feature leads + PM)
• 05:00–12:00 — infra/SRE health snapshot (metrics + known risk)
• 12:00–22:00 — canary rollout plan / owners (assign primary/backup)
• 22:00–28:00 — DB migration final confirm / fallback plan
• 28:00–30:00 — formal go/no-go vote + next steps

Kai: Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/v2.3.2-precut (please read the "migration checklist" section). Also paste quick commands for canary kickoff in thread:
```
# canary rollout snippet
redwood deploy --env prod --canary 5% --strategy rolling --owner @Rory
```

Maya: For backups: I'll be backup for canary A, Rory primary. Jules can be backup for canary B?

Jules: I can backup canary B. Confirmed. I'll also verify the migration dry-run logs are green by EOD.

Rory: I'll own canary A primary. @Maya if you can watch ops dashboard during roll that's great.

PM-Jen: Feature leads: @Olivia and @Sam — please be on the 5m handoff. If you can't, DM me alternatives.

Kai: Poll seems to favor slot 1 so I'm tentatively locking Tue 08:30 PT. If anyone still prefers slot 2 react with :two: by EOD or I'll finalize invite tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created (tentative) for Tue 2026-03-24 08:30 PT — attendees: Kai, Maya, Rory, Jules, PM-Jen, Olivia, Sam.

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll run the SRE pre-check at 07:45 PT and post the short status here.

Jules: I'll post migration dry-run summary in this thread by 19:00 PT.

Kai: Thanks — quick ownership recap before we wrap: canary A = Rory (primary) / Maya (backup), canary B = Olivia (primary) / Jules (backup), migration owner = Jules, feature handoff = Olivia + Sam + PM-Jen. If anything changes, update the calendar attendees.

Rory: noted. See you at 08:30 PT.

Kai: Closing thread for now — will publish final invite and agenda doc in #eng-releases channel once slot confirmed. Thanks all.
